svg.title: HomeAutomationMonitorGW architecture
svg.desc: Hand-drawn architecture diagram showing SNMPv3 and NUT inputs, configuration files, independent collectors, in-memory cache, authenticated read-only REST API, and Zabbix as an example consumer.
svg.text: Read-only collection • independent sources • cached HTTPS snapshots

g.text: last known good metrics • timestamps • discovery
one isolated state per configured source
HTTP reads cache only — never starts a device poll

svg.text: One failed source does not stop the others.

g.text: SNMP GET or NUT LIST VAR

svg.text: Read-only by design: no SNMP SET, no client-selected target, no persistent metric database.
